lines.en: Be it unmarked graves or containers of soup. Be it troubles or bubbles or birds in a coop.
I’m a daughter to slaughter, the laughter soon after. A welcome mat welcoming act full of chatter.
While I know that you worry, don’t hurry, time’s stopped! There’s no need to get out of that chair you’ve got.
If anything many things beckon your notice. On your knees, God’s presenting, commanding you “blow this.”
So you do! And, oh! How delicious it tastes!
These subservient perversions, these ol’ quantum aversions, they combine to make You and enhance the immersion!
Please enjoy your stay in the place that you are for the places you aren’t are now CLOSED.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Where the fuck am I now?! I was so close to doing something and now I don’t even know what I was close to doing!
: Isn’t something pink supposed to be there?! To cut this white in two while I spend the night with you?!
: Wait, who are you?! And why did I say that when I’m entirely, completely, unmistakably alone?! Stop hijacking my mind, secret invisible Nodoka! I know you’re there! I know you’re judging me!

: And because I know these things, I also know that locking me in a liminal white space is little more than a malicious attempt to invoke my historical musings on colorblindness and subsequently beat me down into a girl more susceptible to brainwashing!
: I am smarter than you! Smarter than me! And I can easily remember how to move these limbs and exit this chair! I just haven’t tried yet!
: Waiter? Yes, hello. Just a coffee please. Black. Thank you. And no, I’m not writing a screenplay.
: What, this? Just research on how to get from here to there. Have you ever used a GPS? Cool, well it’s nothing like that. 店内で。

: My number?! Are you sure? Even though I’ve been repeatedly passionately reamed by a man twice my age and twice my size? That doesn’t bother- oh, you meant my order number. 1232. Ha ha ha. I’m so silly.
: FUCK! NO! I didn’t come here to not work on my screenplay! I came here because...think, Nodoka! Library! You were in a library! There was a book! Your book! A book full of tips and-
: AH-HAH! I REMEMBER HOW TO WALK NOW! I CAN ONLY SUPPRESS MYSELF FOR SO LONG!
: I MUST PICK UP ORDER 1232 FROM THE COUNTER BEFORE SOME FUCKING ASSHOLE GETS THEIR GRUBBY UNINTELLECTUAL HANDS ALL OVER IT!!!!
Each step Nodoka took caused a large satin curtain covering a window to another world (?) to slightly raise until it receded into the ceiling and left her staring blankly at a room with clocks.
There were other things in the room too, though. Not just the one she was looking at, but the one she was in.

As we speak, beings are slowly materializing in my place. And while all that currently tangibly exists are two nervous systems, the rest of the meat will be here soon and then the meat will learn to speak.
This makes my system nervous too!
: Fascinating. A Passer montanus. Just the like the one we have in the dorm. And what an interesting enclosure for it.
The bird chirps delightedly.

: Are you eating well, my sudden avian companion? Those sunflowers are far too large for you. You should be feasting on something smaller. Like millet. Do you want some millet? Where can I get some millet?
The bird chirps delightedly again. It’s in a good mood probably. And the meat is still forming.
: Is this truly all yours, bird? Are you not lonely, having such a large box to yourself?

: I often feel the same, you know. Are there things in there you’re not allowed to use? Does your master give you rules on what you can and can not enrich yourself with? Or are you masterless, like me?
Chirp chirp chirp. Meat soon. She hears mild chatter through the door through the mirror. Less like teeth, more like people.
: Okay. HEAD IN THE GAME. Like you’re playing FOOTBALL, Nodoka. Like it’s fucking FOOTBALL. How do I play FOOTBALL?
: BIRD! HELP!
The chirp birds delightedly.
: I’ve found myself in fucking SYMBOLISM again! All I want is to use a fucking DOOR but the only DOOR in here is on the other side of a WINDOW. This implication is FUCKING SHIT!
: We can show you the way if you’re lost, Nagasawa-san.
: Get out of my FUCKING CHAIR!!!!!!
: Please forgive Moyo here. Her legs aren’t what they used to be. They’re actually legs now.
: Cool. I DON’T FUCKING CARE. Where’s the library?! I HAVE OVERDUE BOOKS TO RETURN!

: The library is a long way from here, Nagasawa-san. You were captured by the Gardener and put into detention. Your only option now is to either do as we say or spend the next nine hours and twenty minutes here.
: NINE HOURS and TWENTY MINUTES?! That’s almost the exact runtime of the 1985 Holocaust documentary, “Shoah!”
: Why do you know that?
: Because I’m SMART! I know EVERYTHING! Except all of the things that are happening HERE! Now, why are you so fucking LONG all of a sudden?!
: Forgive me for not properly introducing myself. I am me. And this is her. And we’re here today to try and get you to join our company softball team.
: Turn that one off. She disgusts me with her unusual frequency.
: You’ll get used to it in time. Which it seems you’re running out of, if what my sources tell me is true.
: AHHHHHHH! Get the fucking DVD player! I’ll just skip to the second half of Shoah!
: Are you always this rambunctious during fits of frantic delirium?
: Where’s the fucking BARISTA with my COFFEE? 1232! I’VE BEEN WAITING HERE FOREVER!
: I said COFFEE, not EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!
: Apologies, Nagasawa-san. Moyo’s been very eager to show off her paper lantern tongue rings and kanji tattoos lately. Two things that you could have as well if only you join our softball team.
: I don’t have time for SOFTBALL! Those tongue rings are certainly intriguing, though. Do you know whose bird this is?
: I haven’t hated something this much since Walden. How much longer does it have to live?
: She’s already well past her expiration date. But so is your mother and she’s still clinging to life, isn’t she?
: My mother?...
: How do you know about my mother?
: The same way we know about you. You’re on a different side of the screen. A commercial from a different decade. One who wants to know her origin, but has been unable to figure anything out.
: LIES! My origin could be a puddle of fucking MANATEE SEMEN for all I care! What I want to know is HOW? WHY? And if she can even SEE ME.
: And these are answers we can help you find. But not without first establishing a contract.
: How does ten years for $700,000,000 sound? It’s the same contract Shohei Ohtani got from the Los Angeles Dodgers, but without any of the deferrals.
: I have no use for MONEY! TIME is fucking INFINITE! Anything I WANT I can just TAKE!
: Not knowledge. And you have to admit, it irks you not knowing something that other people do know, doesn’t it?
: Your whole life, you’ve existed on a plane much different from everyone else. Unable to connect. Unable to understand. And it’s all for good reason.
: You are special, Nagasawa-san. An entity that, by all accounts, should not exist. Yet you do. And, in that regard, the two of us are rather similar.
: You are the byproduct of mistakes never made. The unripe fruit of virgin birth. One that, when eaten, would condemn man to a life of sin.
: It’s no wonder you’re such a floppy little fish-girl!
: I am not a fish-girl. You take that back, you fucking mutant. What else do you know about Kyoko?
: What else do you know about her?
: All of your knowledge comes from books. Mementos. Articles left behind that you’ve dedicated yourself to deciphering, yet repeatedly fail behind the scenes much to your own genius dismay!
: It’s so sad! The one thing you actually want to know is the one thing you can’t because anything you learn would make it harder for you to learn anything else!

: You fear death the same way we all do. But you also fear deathless uncertainty. You fear the deathless unknown. And all of these things are at war with one another. So the time has come to make a choice.
: You can leave Kumon-mi behind. And you may come with us to the Sanctuary, where we will tell you everything you have ever wanted to know about everything there is to know.
: What’s the catch? And if you mention fucking softball again, I swear to god.
: The catch is that Kyoko dies. Which, let’s face it, she already has.
: There’s nothing in there. There used to be, sure. But those times have never been known to you.
: You never even had a childhood. You just showed up one day and the world rewrote itself. You really think you’re the only one who knows that?
: Come with us. We’ll rewrite it all again. And soon, you can be the Passer montanus, complete with your own little aviary.
: You don’t want me. You want her. And appealing to my thirst for knowledge will do nothing to sate your appetite for reconciliation. I am not so easily led astray.
: You’d rob yourself of the chance to see God? All to protect a mannequin who has never once shown you love?
: Why not tell me what killing her would do for you? If her existence is so devoid of everything, why go to such lengths to put an end to it?
: I’m just a middle-girl. It’s my employer who doesn’t want her to exist anymore. And if said employer could form a contract with someone like you in the process, it sweetens the deal even more.
: I can’t see how when whoever you lot are seem to possess the only bits of information in this world that I lack.
: It’s less about what you know and more about what you can teach.
: We’ve had enough lessons in love for a while, don’t you think?
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!
: ABOUT FUCKING TIME! That elongated CUNT over there has been trying to get me to KILL MY MOM!
: I tried to warn you, Nodoka-chan! But before I knew it, that green guy was tying me up and it only felt kind of good!
: What green guy?! I didn’t see a fucking green guy!
: Because you never pay attention! Anyway, what’s all this about killing your-
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!
: What? Is there another green person now?
: No! I just didn’t realize the twins were here! They’re always so creepy!
: Twins? You and I look more like twins than the two of them do and you’re a fucking stick figure.
: Ugh, really?! I need to stop sharing my garlic bread. This whole time, I thought I was gaining weight, not losing it.
: Anyway! Ready to get out of here? I might not be super useful, but even somebody like me can pull you out of detention!
: If you’re going to kill them, start with the small one.
: Hahahahah! Good idea, Nodoka-chan!
: No.
: Ngah...ahh?!
: I know it hurts, but this is the only way to save you!
: Glchkk....you....f....fucking...traitor!
: Hey, I’m saving you from nine hours and twenty minutes worth of mind games right now! You should be thanking me!
: Warn the...next one! About...their offer! T...glchk...tell her...not to...take it!!!
: Well, duh. I hate their stupid ultimatum even more than you do.
: Mngh...glhpp....mnghhh....chklkhchh...
: Oh, jeez...Yuko-nee’s gonna yell at me for making such a big mess again.
: Moyo. Catch her.
: EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEKKKK!
: Hah...
: Hello, you? It’s me. It happened again.
: Yes, she’s chasing after her right now.
: Yes, that’s-
: Oh.
: Are you sure?
: Well, that’s not good at all.
